name: dual specificity phosphatase 2

function.text: DUSP2 encodes dual specificity protein phosphatase 2. Annotated molecular activities include phosphoprotein phosphatase activity and protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. It participates in signal transduction and endoderm formation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
